body.p: The present application included claims 1-22. Claims 1, 2, 5, 6, 9-18, and 22 have been amended. Claims 19-21 were canceled without prejudice or disclaimer. New claims 23 and 24 have been added.1
Claim 17 was objected to due to an informality. Claim 17 has been amended to render the objection moot.

Claims 1-6, 9, 10, and 12-19 were rejected as being unpatentable over U.S. 3,848,832 ("Stanley") in view of U.S. 2022/0033060 ("Behzadpour"). Claims 7, 8, and 20 were rejected as being unpatentable over Stanley in view of Behzadpour and U.S. 5,524,847 ("Brodell"). Claim 11 was rejected as being unpatentable over Stanley in view of Behzadpour and CN 201660965 ("Liu"). Claim 22 was rejected as being unpatentable over Stanley in view of Behzadpour and U.S. 2016/0229545 ("Pautis").
The Applicant respectfully traverses these rejections for at least the reasons previously set forth during prosecution.

Nevertheless, in order to expedite prosecution toward allowance, claim 18 has been amended to recite the limitations of previously pending claim 21, which was objected to as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but would be allowable if rewritten in independent form. See August 2, 2024 Office Action at page 18. Claims 1 and 13 have been similarly amended. For at least these additional reasons, the Applicant respectfully submits that claims 1, 13, 18, and the claims depending therefrom are in condition for allowance.

As noted, the claims have been amended to expedite prosecution toward allowance. The claim amendments are not to be interpreted as an acknowledgement of the propriety of the claim rejections. The Applicant reserves the right to pursue the subject matter of the claims, as previously recited, in a continuation application.

In general, the Office Action makes various statements regarding the pending claims and the cited references that are now moot in light of the above. Thus, the Applicant will not address such statements at the present time. However, the Applicant expressly reserves the right to challenge such statements in the future should the need arise (e.g., if such statements should become relevant by appearing in a rejection of any current or future claim).

The Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration of the claim rejections for at least the reasons discussed above. If the Examiner has any questions or the Applicant can be of any assistance, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney.
Respectfully Submitted, Date: September 4, 2024 /Joseph M. Butscher/
